notes: Flags: none (boxed for home assembly, 'Effortless Assembly', so F-22 does not apply). A headboard-less platform the size of the mattress: the 76" King mattress overhangs the 75.5" frame by 1/4" on each side. 'Ground To Item Distance 8.5 inches', and one photo shows a robot vacuum underneath. 'Maximum Weight Recommendation 1000 pounds'. Natural pine with a 3.5" solid wood frame and wooden slats, no box spring needed; care 'Spot cleaning with a damp cloth'. Fit (the king brief, master-bedroom): with the headboard side on the right wall and the window-side edge at the bathroom door's landing (y 97), the frame's window-side edge falls at y 21.5 and the mattress's at y 21.25, 15.25" from the heater's drawn face (F-33: 12" for bedding). It is the narrowest frame read. F-34: 21.25" on the window side, from the wall. 79.5" long, so it leaves 97.5" of the room's 177". 4.6 stars (22,813). In Stock (2026-10-24). Brand Mellow (manufacturer Best Price Mattress), part BPM-CSWPB-12KN. Mellow also sells it in Espresso (search result B07DZW2PNH, $200.16, not opened). rooms: master-bedroom, from the king brief.
